about: Four brand-only Solone supplies establish continuous treatment above the dose threshold, and the fracture-risk assessment for this course is pending.
Possible finding: either consecutive run of four prednisone supplies establishes qualifying exposure, but the record holds no line about a fracture-risk assessment for this course.
The dated account of the October regimen separates two courses above the threshold. Neither lasts three months and the later February course lasts five days.
